title: Lafiya da jiki
description: Ten short, simple stories about health and the body in Hausaland: a singer who loses his voice, traditional medicine, a diet without much meat, a fall from a tree, a tired memory, an outbreak near the border, a family's prayers, a man who stops drinking, a doctor abroad and a quarrel that ends in a hospital.

lessons.title: Muryar Ashiru
lessons.summary: Ashiru, a singer in Kano, catches a cough in the cold season and loses his voice; at the health centre the doctor tests him, gives him medicine and tells him how to protect his voice.
lessons.text:
Ashiru yana zaune a Kano. Aikinsa shi ne waƙa. Yana da murya mai kyau ƙwarai, kuma mutane suna cewa muryarsa baiwa ce daga Allah. Ashiru ma yana cewa, "Muryata baiwa ce. Dole in kula da ita."

Lokacin sanyi ya zo. Da dare akwai sanyi sosai a Kano, amma Ashiru bai saka babbar riga ba.

Bayan kwana biyu, sai tari ya kama shi. Yana tari dare da rana. Hancinsa ma yana ciwo, kuma ruwa yana fita daga hancinsa. Muryarsa ba ta fita sosai.

"Ina da babban biki bayan kwana uku," ya ce. "Ta yaya zan yi waƙa da wannan tari?"

Ya tafi cibiyar lafiya da ke kusa da gidansa. A cibiyar akwai mutane da yawa. Wata mace ta ce masa, "Ka zauna ka jira. Likita za ta gan ka."

Ashiru ya zauna ya jira. Ya jira awa ɗaya, sannan ya ƙara jira. Daga baya Likita Karima ta kira shi. Ta duba hancinsa da bakinsa, sannan ta ce, "Zan yi maka gwaji." Ta yi gwajin jini.

Bayan gwajin, ta ce, "Tarinka ba shi da tsanani sosai. Sanyi ne ya kawo shi. Amma idan ba ka kula ba, zai yi tsanani."

"Me zan yi?" Ashiru ya ce.

"Ka sha wannan magani sau uku a rana," ta ce. "Kuma ka kiyaye muryarka. Kada ka yi magana da ƙarfi, kuma kada ka yi waƙa har kwana biyu. Koyaushe ka sha ruwa mai zafi, kuma koyaushe ka saka babbar riga idan akwai sanyi."

Ashiru ya yi abin da likitar ta faɗa. Ya kiyaye muryarsa, ya sha maganin, kuma bai fita da dare ba.

Bayan kwana uku, tarinsa ya tafi, muryarsa kuma ta dawo. Ya yi waƙa a biki, kuma mutane suka ji daɗi ƙwarai.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa mutane suke cewa muryar Ashiru baiwa ce?
Saboda yana da murya mai kyau ƙwarai.
Me ya kama Ashiru a lokacin sanyi?
Tari ya kama shi.
Ina Ashiru ya tafi?
Ya tafi cibiyar lafiya da ke kusa da gidansa.
Wane gwaji likitar ta yi?
Ta yi gwajin jini.
Me likitar ta ce ya yi koyaushe?
Ta ce koyaushe ya sha ruwa mai zafi, kuma ya saka babbar riga idan akwai sanyi.

lessons.title: Maganin gargajiya
lessons.summary: Hasiya's old father Haliru takes a traditional healer's secret medicine for a stomach ache; it does not help, so she takes him to hospital, where the doctor finds the cause and cures it.
lessons.text:
Hasiya tana zaune a Katsina tare da babanta Haliru. Tana kiransa "Baba". Baba Haliru tsoho ne, kuma yana son maganin gargajiya.

Wata rana Baba ya ji ciwon ciki. Bai je asibiti ba. Ya je wurin wani mai maganin gargajiya a kasuwa, Malam Gali. Malam Gali ya ba shi wani magani a cikin ƙaramar kwalba.

"Me ke cikin maganin nan?" Hasiya ta ce.

"Sirri ne," Baba ya ce. "Malam Gali ba ya faɗa wa kowa sirrin maganinsa. Mutum ne mai hikima. Ya samu hikimarsa daga kakanninsa."

Amma Hasiya tana da shakka. "Baba, ina da shakka game da wannan magani," ta ce. "Ba mu san abin da ke cikinsa ba."

Baba ya sha maganin har kwana uku, amma ciwon bai tafi ba. Sai ciwon ya yi tsanani.

A rana ta huɗu, Hasiya ta kai babanta asibiti. Wani likita ya duba shi, sannan ya ce, "Kuskure ne ka sha magani idan ba ka san abin da ke cikinsa ba. Kada ka sake yin wannan kuskure."

"Bari mu nemi tushen ciwon," likitan ya ce. Ya yi masa gwaji. Bayan gwajin, ya ce, "Na gano tushen ciwon. Akwai wata ƙaramar cuta a cikinka. Za mu magance ta da wannan magani."

Baba ya sha maganin asibiti har mako ɗaya. Maganin ya magance cutar, kuma ciwon cikinsa ya tafi.

"Na fahimci kuskurena," Baba ya ce wa likitan. "Allah ya saka maka da alheri."

"Ka yi wa kanka alheri ne," likitan ya ce. "Kowane magani yana da tushe. Dole mu san shi."

Da suka koma gida, Baba ya fahimci cewa 'yarsa tana da gaskiya tun farko. "Ke ma kina da hikima," ya ce mata.

Hasiya ta yi dariya. "Maganin gargajiya yana da kyau wani lokaci," ta ce, "amma ba kowane magani ba ne."

Tambayoyi:
Wane magani Baba Haliru yake so?
Yana son maganin gargajiya.
Me Malam Gali ya ba shi?
Ya ba shi wani magani a cikin ƙaramar kwalba.
Me ya sa Hasiya take da shakka?
Saboda ba su san abin da ke cikin maganin ba.
Me likitan ya gano?
Ya gano tushen ciwon: wata ƙaramar cuta a cikinsa.
Me Baba ya ce wa likitan?
Ya ce, "Na fahimci kuskurena. Allah ya saka maka da alheri."

lessons.title: Abincin Hayatu
lessons.summary: In Zaria, Hayatu eats a lot of meat and is too heavy; the doctor warns him about his heart, his wife Murja makes a plan, and after eight weeks he has lost weight and the pain has gone.
lessons.text:
Hayatu yana zaune a Zaria tare da matarsa Murja. Hayatu yana son nama ƙwarai. Kowace rana yana cin nama kimanin sau uku. Saboda haka yana da nauyi sosai.

Wata rana zuciyarsa ta yi masa ciwo, sai Murja ta kai shi asibiti. Likita ya duba shi, ya ce, "Nauyinka ya yi yawa. Cin nama da yawa yana jawo ciwon zuciya. Mai da ke cikin nama ma yana jawo matsala ga jini. Dole ka yi canji a abincinka."

Da suka koma gida, Murja ta ce, "Ina da dabara. Za mu ci nau'in abinci daban daban. Abincinmu zai ƙunshi kifi da kayan lambu. Nama sau ɗaya kawai a mako. Kuma kowace rana da ƙarfe takwas na safe, za ka yi tafiya da ƙafa kimanin sa'a ɗaya."

"Wannan dabara ce mai kyau," Hayatu ya ce. "Ina so in rage nauyina kafin mako takwas."

Canjin bai yi masa sauƙi ba. A makon farko, yana tunanin nama koyaushe. Amma ya yi yunƙuri sosai. Kowace rana da ƙarfe takwas, yana tafiya kimanin sa'a ɗaya a kan titin da ke kusa da gidansu.

Murja ma ta yi yunƙuri. Ta nemi wani sabon nau'in abinci a kasuwa. Kowane abincin da take yi ya ƙunshi kifi ko kayan lambu, kuma babu mai da yawa a cikinsa.

Bayan mako takwas, Hayatu ya koma asibiti. Likitan ya duba nauyinsa, sannan ya yi farin ciki. "Ka cimma abin da kake so," ya ce. "Ka rage nauyinka sosai."

"Na cimma shi saboda dabarar matata," Hayatu ya ce. "Ita ce ta yi canjin abincinmu."

"Canji ne mai kyau," likitan ya ce. "Kuma zuciyarka ba ta ƙara yi maka ciwo ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me Hayatu yake so ƙwarai?
Yana son nama ƙwarai.
Me likita ya ce game da cin nama da yawa?
Ya ce cin nama da yawa yana jawo ciwon zuciya.
Wane irin abinci Murja ta ce za su ci?
Ta ce abincinsu zai ƙunshi kifi da kayan lambu.
Da ƙarfe nawa Hayatu yake tafiya da ƙafa?
Yana tafiya da ƙarfe takwas na safe.
Bayan mako nawa ya cimma abin da yake so?
Bayan mako takwas.

lessons.title: Faɗuwar Dikko
lessons.summary: Dikko farms and herds cattle near Gombe; he climbs a tall tree on his farm, twists his foot coming down and falls, and his son Kasimu puts ice on it and takes him to hospital.
lessons.text:
Dikko yana noma a wata gona a wajen Gombe. Yana kuma kiwon shanu. Kowace rana shi da ɗansa Kasimu suna zuwa gona. Gonar tana da nisa daga gidansu, saboda haka suna tafiya da wuri.

A gefen gonar akwai wani dogon itace. 'Ya'yan itacen suna da daɗi ƙwarai.

Wata rana Dikko ya ce, "Zan hau wannan dogon itace in cire 'ya'yansa."

"Baba, kada ka hau," Kasimu ya ce. "Itacen yana da tsawo."

"Na hau shi sau da yawa," Dikko ya ce. Sai ya hau itacen. Ya cire 'ya'yan itace da yawa, ya jefa su ƙasa. Kasimu ya kama su. Dikko ya ƙara jefa wasu, Kasimu kuma ya ƙara kama su.

Da ya gama, Dikko ya fara sauka. Amma lokacin da yake sauka, ƙafarsa ta juya, sai ya faɗi ƙasa.

"Ƙafata!" ya ce. Ƙafarsa tana ciwo sosai, kuma ba ya iya juya ta.

Kasimu yana da ruwan sanyi a cikin kwalba, kuma akwai ƙanƙara a cikin ruwan. Ya fitar da ƙanƙarar, ya saka ta a kan ƙafar babansa. Ƙanƙarar ta rage ciwon kaɗan.

Asibiti yana da nisa daga gonar. Kasimu ya taimaka wa babansa ya hau jakinsu, sannan suka tafi asibiti tare. Da suka isa, Kasimu ya taimaka masa ya sauka daga kan jakin.

Likita ya duba ƙafar. "Ƙafarka za ta yi kyau," ya ce. "Amma kada ka yi noma har mako biyu. Kuma kada ka sake hawa dogon itace!"

"Wa zai yi kiwon shanunmu?" Dikko ya ce.

"Ni zan yi," Kasimu ya ce. Har mako biyu Kasimu ya yi kiwon shanun shi kaɗai, kuma ya yi aikin gona.

Bayan mako biyu, Dikko ya koma gona. Ya ga dogon itacen, amma bai hau shi ba.

Tambayoyi:
Me Dikko yake yi a gona?
Yana noma, kuma yana kiwon shanu.
Me ya sa Dikko ya hau itacen?
Ya hau shi domin ya cire 'ya'yansa.
Me ya faru lokacin da yake sauka?
Ƙafarsa ta juya, sai ya faɗi ƙasa.
Me Kasimu ya saka a kan ƙafar babansa?
Ya saka ƙanƙara a kan ƙafarsa.
Wa ya yi kiwon shanu har mako biyu?
Kasimu ne ya yi kiwon shanun.

lessons.title: Ƙwaƙwalwar Nazir
lessons.summary: Nazir, an office assistant in Abuja, works late and watches television until two at night; his memory starts to fail, and his boss Suwaiba tells him to sleep and spend time with his colleagues.
lessons.text:
Nazir mataimaki ne a wani ofishi a Abuja. Shi ne mataimakin Suwaiba, shugabar ofishin. Albashinsa yana da kyau, amma aikinsa yana da yawa.

Kowace rana yana zama a ofishin har ƙarfe 9 na dare. Idan ya koma gida, yana kallon talabijin har ƙarfe 2 na dare. Ba ya yin bacci sosai.

Bayan wata biyu, ƙwaƙwalwarsa ta fara wahala. Ya manta da wani babban taro. Ya manta da inda ya ajiye takardun ofishin. Wata rana ma ya manta da sunan wani abokin aikinsa.

Nazir ya damu. Ya nemi bayanai game da ƙwaƙwalwa a yanar gizo. Akwai bayanai da yawa a yanar gizo, kuma duk sun ce ƙwaƙwalwa tana buƙatar bacci mai yawa.

Abokan aikinsa sun ce masa, "Ka zo mu fita tare bayan aiki." Amma ya ce, "Ba ni da lokaci."

Wata rana Suwaiba ta kira shi. "Shigo," ta ce. Nazir ya shigo ofishin, ya zauna. Ta kalli fuskarsa.

"Na ga kana manta abubuwa da yawa," ta ce. "Me ke faruwa?"

"Ba na yin bacci sosai," Nazir ya ce. "Ina kallon talabijin har dare."

"Ƙwaƙwalwarka ta gaji," ta ce. "Albashi ba shi ne komai ba. Zamantakewa ma tana da muhimmanci. Ka yi bacci, ka yi zama da abokan aikinka da 'yan uwanka."

Daga ranar, Nazir bai ƙara zama a ofishi har dare ba. Bai kalli talabijin bayan ƙarfe 10 ba. Yana yin bacci da wuri. A ƙarshen mako, ya fita tare da abokan aikinsa, suka ci abinci, suka yi dariya.

Bayan wata ɗaya, ƙwaƙwalwarsa ta dawo kamar da. Bai ƙara manta da komai ba. Suwaiba ta ce, "Mataimakina ya dawo!"

Nazir ya ce mata zamantakewa ce ta taimaka masa.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Nazir yake aiki?
Yana aiki a wani ofishi a Abuja.
Me Nazir yake yi idan ya koma gida?
Yana kallon talabijin har ƙarfe 2 na dare.
Me bayanai a yanar gizo suka ce?
Sun ce ƙwaƙwalwa tana buƙatar bacci mai yawa.
Me Suwaiba ta ce masa?
Ta ce ya yi bacci, ya yi zama da abokan aikinsa da 'yan uwansa.
Wa ya fita tare da Nazir a ƙarshen mako?
Abokan aikinsa ne suka fita tare da shi.

lessons.title: Sanarwa a lardi
lessons.summary: Tahir works at a hospital in Cameroon's North province near the Nigerian border; many poor people fall sick from one well, and he and the government announce rules to keep the water and the surroundings clean.
lessons.text:
Tahir yana aiki a wani asibiti a wani ƙaramin gari a lardin Arewa na ƙasar Kamaru. Garin yana kusa da iyakar Najeriya. Mutane da yawa suna zuwa daga ɗaya gefen iyakar kowace rana.

Yawancin mutanen garin talakawa ne. Akwai ƙarancin ruwan sha mai kyau, kuma akwai ƙarancin likitoci.

Wata rana marasa lafiya da yawa suka zo asibitin. Duk suna da ciwon ciki. Bayan kwana ɗaya, wasu marasa lafiya suka zo. Tahir ya yi la'akari da abin da yake gani. Ya ce wa kowane mara lafiya, "Daga ina kuke samun ruwan sha?"

Duk suka ce, "Daga rijiyar da ke kusa da kasuwa."

Tahir ya je ofishin gwamnatin lardin. Ya sanar da shugabannin abin da ya gani. Bayan sun yi la'akari da maganarsa, gwamnatin lardin ta yi sanarwa a rediyo.

Sanarwar ta ce: "Kada kowa ya sha ruwa daga rijiyar kasuwa. Akwai sababbin ƙa'idodi guda biyu. Ƙa'ida ta farko: ku dafa ruwa kafin ku sha shi. Ƙa'ida ta biyu: ku kula da muhallinku, kuma kada ku jefa komai a cikin ruwa."

Tahir ma ya sanar da mutane a kasuwa. Ya ce, "Muhalli mai kyau yana kare lafiyarmu. Talaka ko mai kuɗi, kowa yana buƙatar ruwa mai kyau."

Saboda cutar za ta iya zuwa ɗaya gefen iyaka, Tahir ya kuma sanar da wani asibiti a Najeriya, kusa da iyakar. Su ma suka yi sanarwa ga mutanensu.

Bayan mako biyu, babu sababbin marasa lafiya. Mutane suka bi ƙa'idodin, kuma muhallin garin ya yi kyau. Talakawan garin suka ce, "Allah ya saka wa Tahir da alheri."

Tambayoyi:
Ina garin Tahir yake?
Yana lardin Arewa na ƙasar Kamaru, kusa da iyakar Najeriya.
Akwai ƙarancin me a garin?
Akwai ƙarancin ruwan sha mai kyau da ƙarancin likitoci.
Daga ina marasa lafiyan suke samun ruwa?
Daga rijiyar da ke kusa da kasuwa.
Ina gwamnatin lardin ta yi sanarwa?
Ta yi sanarwa a rediyo.
Me ƙa'ida ta farko take cewa?
Ta ce a dafa ruwa kafin a sha shi.

lessons.title: Addu'ar dangi
lessons.summary: Old Badamasi of Bauchi falls seriously ill; his relatives come and pray for him, and when he is well again he goes with his granddaughter Rahinatu to his late wife's grave to pray and give thanks.
lessons.text:
Malam Badamasi tsoho ne mai shekara 80. Yana zaune a Bauchi tare da 'yar ɗansa, Rahinatu. Shi musulmi ne, kuma kowace rana yana yin addu'a domin danginsa.

Wata rana ya yi rashin lafiya mai tsanani. Rahinatu ta kai shi asibiti. Da dangi suka ji labari, suka zo daga Kano, Gombe da Jos. Duk danginsa suka zauna a asibitin, suka yi masa addu'a.

Abokansa musulmi ma sun zo, suka yi masa addu'a. "Allah ya ba ka lafiya," suka ce.

Bayan kwana goma, Malam Badamasi ya samu sauƙi. Likita ya ce zai iya tafiya gida. Dangi suka yi murna ƙwarai. Rahinatu ta yi murna fiye da kowa.

Rahinatu ta kai shi gidan nasa da ke kusa da kasuwa. Da yamma, ya ce mata, "Mu je kabarin kakarki."

Kakar Rahinatu ta mutu shekara biyar da suka wuce. Kabarinta yana bayan gari.

"Baba, kai fa?" Rahinatu ta ce. "Ba ka jin ciwo?"

"Ba na jin ciwo," ya ce. "Ina so in yi godiya."

Da yamma suka tafi tare a hankali. A gaban kabarin, Malam Badamasi ya yi addu'a domin matarsa. Sannan ya yi godiya ga Allah saboda lafiyarsa, kuma ya yi godiya saboda danginsa.

Da suka koma gidan nasa, ya ce wa Rahinatu, "Ke fa? Kina lafiya?"

Rahinatu ta yi dariya. "Ina lafiya, Baba. Ina jin yunwa kawai."

"To, mu ci abinci tare," ya ce. "Yau ranar murna ce."

Tambayoyi:
Me Malam Badamasi yake yi kowace rana?
Yana yin addu'a domin danginsa.
Daga ina dangi suka zo?
Sun zo daga Kano, Gombe da Jos.
Yaushe suka tafi kabarin?
Sun tafi da yamma.
Kabarin wa suka je?
Sun je kabarin kakar Rahinatu.
Me ya yi a gaban kabarin?
Ya yi addu'a domin matarsa, kuma ya yi godiya ga Allah.

lessons.title: Giyar Gidado
lessons.summary: Gidado in Jos drinks every day, which ruins his health and his wealth; when his wife Balaraba asks for a divorce he stops, and his life improves.
lessons.text:
Gidado yana zaune a Jos tare da matarsa Balaraba. A da, yana da dukiya mai yawa: gidaje biyu da wani babban shago.

Amma Gidado yana shan giya kowace rana. Giya ta lalata lafiyarsa. Idonsa ya yi ja, kuma hannunsa yana rawa. Giyar ta kuma lalata dukiyarsa: ya sayar da gida ɗaya domin ya sayi giya.

Idan yana tafiya a titi da dare, sai ya faɗi ƙasa tamkar ƙaramin yaro. Mutane suna yi masa ba'a. Ba'ar tana ɓata masa rai, amma bai daina shan giya ba.

Tsakaninsa da matarsa akwai faɗa koyaushe. Wata rana Balaraba ta ce, "Ina neman saki. Ba zan iya zama da mutumin da giya ta lalata ba."

Gidado ya ji tsoro. "Saki?" ya ce. "Saki mummunan abu ne. Ki ba mani dama ɗaya."

"Ka faɗa mani gaskiya," Balaraba ta ce. "Za ka daina?"

"Zan daina," ya ce. "Tsakanina da Allah, zan daina."

Tunda Balaraba ta yi wannan magana, Gidado bai sake shan giya ba. Makon farko yana da wahala ƙwarai. Kansa yana ciwo, kuma bai iya bacci ba. Amma ya ce, "Mummunan lokaci ne, amma zai wuce."

Tunda ya daina giya, lafiyarsa ta dawo. Idonsa ya daina ja, kuma hannunsa ya daina rawa. Ya koma aiki a shagonsa, kuma ya fara samun kuɗi. Yanzu yana aiki tamkar sabon mutum.

Mutanen da suke yi masa ba'a a da, yanzu suna yi masa magana da kyau. Tsakaninsa da Balaraba kuma babu faɗa.

"Ina farin ciki da ka ji maganata," Balaraba ta ce.

"Ni ma ina farin ciki," Gidado ya ce. "Ki ci gaba da ba mani shawara."

Tambayoyi:
Me Gidado yake sha kowace rana?
Yana shan giya kowace rana.
Me giya ta lalata?
Ta lalata lafiyarsa da dukiyarsa.
Me mutane suke yi masa a titi?
Suna yi masa ba'a.
Me Balaraba take nema?
Tana neman saki.
Me ya faru tunda Gidado ya daina giya?
Lafiyarsa ta dawo, kuma ya fara samun kuɗi.

lessons.title: Likita a Amurka
lessons.summary: Mahmud, a doctor from Kaduna, moves to America for work and sends dollars home; his mother's letter reminds him that West Africa needs doctors, and he comes back to teach young doctors in Kaduna.
lessons.text:
Mahmud likita ne daga Kaduna. Bayan ya gama karatu, ya yi hijira zuwa Amurka. Likitoci da yawa daga yammacin Afirka suna yin hijira domin neman aiki.

A Amurka, Mahmud ya samo aiki a wani babban asibiti. Albashinsa yana da yawa: yana samun dala dubu da yawa kowane wata. Kowane wata yana aika wa mahaifiyarsa dala ɗari biyar.

Koyon aiki a sabon asibiti bai yi masa sauƙi ba, amma ya yi ƙoƙari. Duk da haka, yana tunanin yarensa. A asibitin, babu wanda yake magana da yarensa.

Wata rana mahaifiyarsa ta aika masa da wasiƙa a rubuce. A cikin wasiƙar ta ce: "Mahmud, ina godiya da dalar da kake aika mana. Amma a garinmu akwai marasa lafiya da yawa, kuma likitoci kaɗan ne. Mutane suna magana da yarenka, kuma suna buƙatar ka."

Mahmud ya karanta wasiƙar sau uku. Sannan ya aika mata da amsa a rubuce: "Zan dawo."

Bayan shekara biyu, ya koma Kaduna. Ya samo aiki a jami'ar garin. Yanzu yana koya wa matasan likitoci aiki.

"Me ya sa ka dawo?" wani ɗalibi ya ce masa.

"Yammacin Afirka tana buƙatar likitoci," Mahmud ya ce. "Na yi hijira domin koyo, kuma koyon ya ba ni ilimi mai yawa. Yanzu ina so in koya muku abin da na sani."

Albashinsa a Kaduna bai kai na Amurka ba. Ba ya samun dala kamar da. Amma yana magana da marasa lafiya da yarensu, kuma mahaifiyarsa tana kusa da shi.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Mahmud ya yi hijira?
Ya yi hijira zuwa Amurka.
Me yake aika wa mahaifiyarsa kowane wata?
Yana aika mata dala ɗari biyar.
Me mahaifiyarsa ta aika masa?
Ta aika masa da wasiƙa a rubuce.
Ina Mahmud ya samo aiki a Kaduna?
Ya samo aiki a jami'ar garin.
Me yake yi yanzu?
Yana koya wa matasan likitoci aiki.

lessons.title: Yarjejeniya a ƙauye
lessons.summary: Near Yola, a quarrel between farmers and herders grows after cattle are killed and young Bukar is shot in the leg; Doctor Salamatu cares for him, and while he is in hospital the village leaders make an agreement.
lessons.text:
A wani ƙauye kusa da Yola, akwai adawa tsakanin masu noma da masu kiwo. Masu kiwo suna cewa masu noma sun yi noma a kan hanyoyin shanunsu. Masu noma kuma suna cewa shanu suna cin amfanin gonakinsu.

Wata rana aka yi kisan shanu biyu a wata gona. Bayan kisan shanun, adawar ta yi tsanani.

Bukar wani saurayi ne daga gidan masu kiwo. Wani dare, yana tafiya gida, sai wani ya harbe shi da bindiga a ƙafa. Mutanen ƙauyen suka kai shi asibiti a Yola.

A asibitin, wata likita mai suna Salamatu ta duba shi. Ta duba bugun zuciyarsa. "Bugun zuciyarka yana da sauri," ta ce. "Kada ka ji tsoro."

Ta ba shi katin asibiti. "Ka riƙe wannan kati," ta ce. "Duk lokacin da ka zo, ka nuna mana katin."

Bukar ya zauna a wani ɗaki. A jikin bangon ɗakin akwai talabijin, kuma a ɗaya bangon akwai hoton wani ƙauye mai kyau. Bukar yana kallon hoton da ke jikin bango, yana tunanin ƙauyensu.

Wata rana ya kalli labarai a talabijin. Shugabannin masu noma da na masu kiwo sun zauna tare. Sun yi yarjejeniya: babu bindiga a ƙauyen, kuma babu kisan dabbobi. Shanu za su bi hanyoyinsu, kuma ba za su shiga gonaki ba.

"Wannan yarjejeniya tana da kyau," Salamatu ta ce.

Bayan mako uku, ranar fitowarsa daga asibiti ta zo. Salamatu ta sake duba bugun zuciyarsa. "Yanzu bugun zuciyarka yana lafiya," ta ce.

A ranar fitowarsa, Bukar ya ce mata, "Allah ya saka miki da alheri." Sannan ya koma ƙauyensu, inda babu adawa yanzu.

Tambayoyi:
Tsakanin wa da wa akwai adawa?
Akwai adawa tsakanin masu noma da masu kiwo.
Me ya faru a wata gona?
An yi kisan shanu biyu.
Me Salamatu ta duba?
Ta duba bugun zuciyar Bukar.
Me Salamatu ta ba shi?
Ta ba shi katin asibiti.
Me shugabannin suka yi?
Sun yi yarjejeniya cewa babu bindiga kuma babu kisan dabbobi.
